$comment: Ovrly contracts 0.3.0-draft (pre-1.0). Mirrors backend/services/api/schemas.py Assessment and EvidenceRelation.
title: Assessment
description: The pipeline's reading of one claim against its evidence in one report version: one relation per piece of evidence consulted, an overall aggregate, and whether the aggregate is still provisional (more evidence or media may follow). There is no report-level verdict. insufficient and insufficient_evidence describe the evidence, not the truth of the claim, and never describe a processing failure: a failed investigation has no assessments at all.

claim_id.description: The assessed claim; refers to a claim in the same report version.

version.description: Report version this assessment belongs to. A correction or expansion creates a new version with new assessments; earlier ones are not edited.

relations.description: One entry per piece of evidence the assessment consulted. May be empty when nothing relevant was found, in which case overall is insufficient_evidence.

provisional.description: True while the investigation may still change this assessment (live capture in progress, partial coverage, expansion pending).

summary.description: One or two plain-English sentences for the overlay or report. Must not imply a blanket true or false verdict about the video.

evidence_id.description: Refers to an evidence item in the same report version.

note.description: Why the evidence relates as stated, or null.
